verifies.G017-C1: the embedded identifier action lists @Embeddable classes of the project for selection: a plain public Serializable embeddable PairKey (public no-arg constructor, equals/hashCode, two scalar fields) written by setup is among the picker's options. The plugin's key discovery is deliberately strict: java.lang types must be spelled canonically (java.lang.Long, java.lang.Object, @java.lang.Override) or imported explicitly, because a bare Long could be shadowed by a same-package type and there is no compiler to resolve it; the setup uses that spelling. Whether every @Embeddable is listed is not claimed here.
